title: Swimmer drowning South Beach Skerries
description: Swimmer drowned at South Beach in shallow surf after rip formed near the groyne. NE wind 15kts, swell 1.4m, spring tide. RNLI Skerries recovered casualty.

title: Two teenagers rescued Skerries Harbour
description: Two teenagers swept off pier by wave. NE swell 1.6m, wind ENE 12kts, spring tide surge. Rescued by RNLI ILB.

title: RNLI Skerries callout — swimmer in difficulty
description: Swimmer in difficulty 200m offshore. ESE wind 14kts, swell 1.2m, spring tide ebb. RNLI towed to safety.

title: Paddleboarder rescued off Skerries Island
description: Paddleboarder carried offshore in wind shadow eddy. NE 20kts, tide ebbing fast. Coast guard helicopter. Swell 1.0m.
